scope: Gazebo 5c-2 only: single-ball delivery, bounce/retention, practical basket capacity and full-basket motion retention; no multi-ball intake or launch claim

delivery_matrix.preload_method: dynamic fall from deterministic low-discrepancy release points above the open basket; no final grid placement

capacity_probe.closure_definition: first probed resulting total with fewer than 3/3 retained collection successes or persistent entrance occupancy

success_semantics.collection_success: new ball crosses the basket entrance and remains inside through a 2 s dwell
success_semantics.bounce_out: new ball crosses the entrance, then leaves the basket containment bounds
success_semantics.entrance_blocked: a ball centre persistently occupies the central entrance prism during the final 1 s dwell

criteria.name: core_delivery_success_count
criteria.rationale: Each requested 0/10/25/40 preload condition must retain the new ball in every repeat.

criteria.name: collection_success
criteria.rationale: Separates successful capture/retention from path quality.

criteria.name: bounce_out
criteria.rationale: A ball that later exits is not retained.

criteria.name: entrance_blocked
criteria.rationale: The new delivery must not leave the next intake path persistently closed.

criteria.name: motion_ball_loss_count
criteria.rationale: No ball may leave the basket during 0.6 m/s travel, braking or moving turn.

physics_limitations: Incoming ball to ground/flywheel uses the unchanged calibrated tennis_ball_compliant analytical law.
Basket, ramp and ball-to-ball contacts are native DART rigid contacts; ball-to-ball restitution/compliance is not calibrated, so contact forces and exact rebound amplitudes are diagnostic only.
All repeats are deterministic seeds, not manufacturing or clay-court uncertainty Monte Carlo.
